zero-person-work.title: Stamping jig
zero-person-work.label: A stamping jig over a conveyor belt. A motor drives the belt, and each card that passes under the ram gets the same mark. The hand crank used for the first card rests in its cradle on the base.

everyone-ships.title: Launch pad
everyone-ships.label: A model rocket on a launch mount beside a service tower. The tower arm pulls back, the console counts down, the rocket climbs out of the frame, and the next one is set on the pad.

everyone-profitable.title: Balance scale
everyone-profitable.label: A balance scale. The left pan holds a crate that stands for what a project costs; coins drop one by one from a hopper onto the right pan. Once the coins outweigh the crate the beam tips and the needle crosses zero: the project pays for itself.

own-outcomes.title: Torque wrench
own-outcomes.label: A pump cover held by eight bolts, seven of them torqued and striped. A torque wrench seats the one loose bolt with short ratchet strokes until its dial reads the target, then the bolt gets its own stripe.

no-meetings.title: Typewriter
no-meetings.label: A typewriter. Each key that strikes moves the carriage one letter to the left and the line on the paper grows; at the end of a line the carriage returns. When the page is full it goes to the outbox tray, where the stack of shipped pages grows.

make-fast-faster.title: Marble run
make-fast-faster.label: Two marble lanes down the same incline. The back lane has two gates, a handoff and an approval, that each hold the marble. The front lane is the same track with both gates removed; only their bolt holes are left. Timers on the finish block show both runs.
